newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best puts Chubb rating under review.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best puts Chubb rating under review.

text.p: Rating agency A.M. Best Co said on Tuesday it had placed under review its "A+" rating for Chubb Life Insurance Co as the company's parent makes a strategic evaluation of it.
The agency said it had given Chubb Life such a high rating because the company enjoyed the financial strength and marketing presence of the Chubb Group of property/casualty companies.
But it said it had put the rating under review as the group reconsidered its relationship with Chubb Life, based in Concord, N.H.
The agency said it had also put under review its "A+" rating for Chubb Sovereign Life Insurance Co and "A" rating for Chubb Colonial Life Insurance Co.
